title: SmartItemsMod
description: Smart Items is a mod that makes dropped items in the game more "intelligent" and beautiful! No more searching for items lost in grass or darkness.
body:
Smart Items 🌟
Makes dropped items visible and intelligent!

🏷️ Floating colored labels on ALL items

🎨 Glowing & animated names

🧲 Items fly to you when far away

🌙 Easy to find in dark or grass

Just drop and forget — items will find you!

For Minecraft 1.20.1 • Forge
